description: A Perl script for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images, including reading, writing, and partition management.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads data to total length with 0xFF bytes.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block_size greater than or equal to data length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary partition entry with name, address, size, and skips.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a partition entry and returns its components or terminates on table end.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Finds the partition table within firmware data.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses the partition table into an array of partition info.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 block.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Generates trailer data (not used currently).

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints contents of the RedBoot trailer.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition and adjusts Kernel and Ramdisk offsets.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Populates partitions based on firmware's partition table.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Verifies and assigns start/size for partitions, handling overlaps and padding.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Builds binary partition table data from partition info.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Assembles and writes the firmware image from partitions.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity checks partition table data.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints human-readable partition info.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Returns default partition layout.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads firmware image into partitions.

methods.name: writeOutFirmwareParts
methods.description: Writes partition data to files.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Reads partition data from files.
